scope: Actual Qt/egui pointer and modifier lifecycle plus strict source preview item-paint primitive pixels; no full UI/GPU framebuffer claim.

preview_law.total: No prospective total preview. Total is authored only at finish for a chain with at least two segments.
preview_law.forced_offset: Before separation is committed, source uses aligned segment normal even when measurement axis is forced.
preview_law.modifier: Shift-only key events are inert for runs because _ortho_anchor ignores chain points; actual Shift-bearing mouse moves update the remembered measurement axis.

observer.path: Actual retained _preview.path elements and actual _preview.paint delegation with original scene transform; no reconstructed source expected paths or graphics visibility mutation.
observer.viewport: Actual view.viewport().grab image retained separately from strict primitive comparison.
observer.immutability: Actual item-paint observer preserves composition, pending state, histories, selection, panel owner and source local epoch. Epoch is a readonly diagnostic bound within each runtime, not a cross-runtime version identity.
observer.native: Full App input and production preview paint callback. Capture actual submitted CAD callback spans/palette/pose from FullOutput, with declared density/integer device origin; do not call a standalone preview builder to substitute for actual paint.

boundaries: offset hover before and after H/V modifier changes
fixed separation chain jog and baseline stack
seeded run hover before first new click
explicit absence of prospective total before finish
short run and total after finish
Escape, tool, sheet and history/rebuild retirement/revival
same hover and idle repaint cache reuse without document/UUID/history changes
capture_gate: One actual original capture only after full producer/observer prereview. Existing 220 run states are reused, not recaptured.
